questions.q: Which statement best describes a primary source?
options: A drawing or photo you made yourself from direct experience
A page from an art book
questions.why: Primary sources are first-hand: your own drawings and photos.

questions.q: Why measure with a pencil at arm's length?
questions.why: Arm's length measuring lets you compare sizes of parts of the object.

questions.q: In AO3, the phrase 'as work progresses' means
options: Record only in the final piece
questions.why: AO3 evidence should appear all through the project.

questions.q: Give two ways to make a photograph useful in your sketchbook.
questions.model: Take your own photos from varied angles and light, then draw from or crop and annotate them to show development.
